review: The curve is upside down. I see pass rates of 80, 30, 27, 13, 77, 100, 53 and 20 percent, so stages 2 to 4 are harder than stages 5 and 6. Spike Garden is the worst: mid and high players stand at a step with spikes on top and give up, which is a layout fault, not a skill test. First Steps also stalls a mid player in front of a small spike pair. Laser Gate kills at 18 percent after two seconds with no safe first laser. Spring Loaded has no risk at all. Crumble Bridge teaches, then tests, and reads well.
best: Crumble Bridge introduces crumbling tiles on safe ground, adds one saw later, and lands in the target band.
worst: Spike Garden stops even the high-skill player at a spiked step with no readable way forward.
